style: Say in an easy-going, encouraging way, like a relaxed sports coach
lines: Pick a part and press Play. Tap your part on the pad or the space bar.
Tap the pad or the space bar with each click. Eight clicks, as steady as you can.
Press Calibrate to start the eight clicks, or press Play to join the band.
Got it. Your timing is set.
Those taps were uneven. Press Calibrate and try again.
Dots above the line were early. Dots below were late. Try to keep them on the line.
Fewer players now. Listen to who's left and lock in with them.
Press Play. The band plays four bars, drops out for four, then comes back. Keep tapping on your own.
You rushed while the band was out.
You dragged while the band was out.
You held steady on your own.
Your taps were too uneven to tell. Try again, nice and even.
When the band came back, you were right with them.
When the band came back, you were apart. Listen for beat one.
Play eight bars. Your best take becomes the ghost to beat. Press Play.
New best. That's your new ghost.
The ghost holds. Press Play to try again.
No taps yet. Press Play, then tap the space bar or the pad on your part's notes.
A lot of notes went by. Slide Speed down and press Play.
